needed.evidence: Visible absence of a footway and people walking in the road on the right side throughout the clip.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk of at least 1 metre width along the right side of the road.

needed.evidence: Visible absence of a footway and people walking in the road on the left side in frames 3 and 4.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk of at least 1 metre width along the left side of the road.

needed.evidence: Visible crossing demand as people are walking across the roadway in multiple frames (1, 2, and 4).
needed.suggestion: Add a marked zebra crossing with a refuge island to facilitate and protect pedestrian crossings at this location.

needed.evidence: No visible dropped kerbs or ramps for pedestrian crossing at any crossing points.
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at crossing points to assist pedestrians, especially at zebra crossings or areas with high pedestrian activity.

needed.evidence: Insufficient street lighting, visible across all frames, especially during low light conditions.
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights to ensure adequate illumination of the road and improve safety for both pedestrians and drivers.
